strings.거기 가는 모험가님~ 안녕? 잠시만 시간 돼~?: Hey, adventurer! Hello! Got a moment?
strings.(앳된 소녀의 목소리가 불러 세운다.): (A young girl's voice calls me to a stop.)
strings.(예쁜 얼굴… 모르는 사람이다.): (A pretty face... but someone I don't know.)
strings.모험가님이 격투장에서 싸우는 거 다 봤어-♬ 꺄~ 완전 강해, 멋.있.어: I watched you fight in the arena! ♪ Eee! You're so strong. So. Cool. ♥
strings.당신처럼 강한 모험가님을 기다리고 있었어~ 잠깐 나랑 차나 한잔 하지 않: I've been waiting for a strong adventurer like you. Want to have a cup of tea with me?
strings.(이상한 사람인 것 같다. 빨리 자리를 피하자.): (She seems strange. I'd better get away.)
strings.잠깐! 잠깐!! 무시하지마! 헌팅 아니거든요?! 잡상인도 아니에요!: Wait! Wait!! Don't ignore me! I'm not trying to pick you up! And I'm not selling anything!
strings.아웬한테 듣고 만나보러 온거라구, %s씨!!: Awen told me about you, so I came to meet you, %s!
strings.우리 모험가님, 한 번에 낚이질 않네. 우훗♥: Our adventurer doesn't take the bait on the first try. Hehe. ♥
All right, all right. Enough joking. I'll explain properly.
My name is Parmila. I'm the leader of the Oscuras Mercenaries.
strings.아- 그 표정. 익숙해. 이렇게 어리고 약해보이는 여자애가 용병단장이라구: Ah, that expression. I'm used to it. You're wondering how a girl who looks so young and weak could lead a mercenary company, right?
strings.아쉽겠지만 진짜거든요~: Sorry to disappoint you, but it's true!
The truth is, I have a little problem, so I'm looking for a skilled adventurer.
strings.내가 워-낙에 바쁜 사람이라~ 사회 생활에 좀 소홀했더니… 그다지 아는: I'm such a busy person that I've neglected my social life... I hardly know anyone. Sniff.
strings.이전부터 아웬과 아인스트씨한테서 당신 이름은 꽤 들었거든~: I've heard your name quite often from Awen and Einst.
And from Ambrosia and Jade too.
Oh, Lena talks about you as well.
strings.(…소녀는 꽤 마당발인 것 같다.): (...She seems to know quite a lot of people.)
strings.어쨌든 들어보니 꽤 믿을만한 사람이다 싶어서 말이지. 아까보니 실력도 괜: Anyway, from what I've heard, you seem trustworthy. And from what I saw earlier, your skills look good too...
strings.그래서 말인데. 혹시 의뢰도 받아? 바쁘지 않으면 나 좀 도와주지 않을래: So, do you take requests? If you're not busy, would you help me?
strings.자세한 이야기는 자리를 옮겨서 하고 싶은데…: I'd like to explain the details somewhere else...
strings.일단 수락해준다면 신비한 숲 쪽으로 함께 이동해서 마저 이야기 하도록 할: If you accept, we'll go to the Mysterious Forest together, and I'll tell you the rest.
1. No, I don't intend to go with you.
If you change your mind, come find me deeper in the Mysterious Forest.
2. Go to the Mysterious Forest with Parmila.
strings.그래! 그런 쿨한 태도 아주 좋아해!: Yes! I love that cool attitude!
strings.그래! 그런 쿨한 태도 아주 좋아해! 그럼 지금 바로 이동하자. 워프할: Yes! I love that cool attitude! Then let's go right now. We'll warp there, so hold on tight!
strings.(이 곳은…예전에 플라티나씨와 왔었던...): (This place... I came here with Platina before...)
strings.아직 초입이고 사람들의 왕래는 거의 없는 곳이지만 여기는…아, 이미 와본: We're only at the entrance, and hardly anyone passes through, but this is... Oh, you've been here before? Impressive. This expedition is our first visit.
strings.제국의 마법사들이 임페리얼 게이트를 우리가 머무르고 있는 주둔지 쪽으로: The Empire's mages temporarily connected the Imperial Gate to our camp.
strings.우리를 만나러 오려면 저 게이트를 지나오는 방법 밖에 없으니까 잊지 말고: That gate is the only way to come see us, so remember it.
By 'us,' I mean my mercenary company on the other side of the Imperial Gate.
strings.이제 이거 타고 저 쪽으로 넘어갈 건데 말이지…그전에…: We're about to take it across... but first...
strings.제국의 의뢰야. 목적은 '미르간디아 탐사': It's a request from the Empire. Our objective is to explore Mirgandia.
strings.개발할 건덕지가 있어 보이는 거나, 신비한 생물, 혹은 유적이나- 뭐,: Anything that looks promising for development, mysterious creatures, ruins... You could call it treasure hunting.
strings.이런 거에 큰 돈을 쏟아붓는 귀족들 속은 알 수가 없다니까. 그 정도 돈: I don't understand nobles who pour huge sums into things like this. There are so many other useful ways to spend that much money.
strings.물론 이 정도 일로 이런 짭잘한 보수라면 엎드려 구두라도 핥을 수 있지만: Of course, for such a handsome payment for this kind of work, I'd even get down and lick their shoes.
strings.(파르밀라는 대화 내용과 상반되는 귀여운 표정으로 방긋 웃었다.): (Parmila smiles sweetly, her expression at odds with what she just said.)
strings.2. 용병단에 대해: 2. Tell me about the mercenary company.
My people? They're all kind, strong, good people.
strings.음, 좀 바보같은 놈들이 한 둘 있긴 한데…: Well, there are one or two idiots...
But they're fools, so you can just ignore them.
strings.아,아냐. 직접 만나고 나서 이야기하자. 모두와 사이좋게 지내줘야 해?: No, never mind. Let's talk after you meet them. Get along with everyone, all right?
strings.(순간 파르밀라의 표정이 어두웠던 것 같은데…기분 탓일까?): (For a moment, Parmila's expression seemed to darken... Was I imagining it?)
Go through that Imperial Gate to reach our temporary camp. I'll see you there.
strings.여기가 우리의 임시 주둔지야. 어수선해보이겠지만 대파된 이 지역에서 이: This is our temporary camp. It may look disorganized, but finding somewhere this usable in such a devastated region took a lot of work!
strings.임페리얼 게이트는 이 쪽으로 바로 통하도록 연결해놨으니, 언제든지 부담없: The Imperial Gate is connected directly here, so feel free to visit anytime. Now, first...
strings.미안, %s. 일단 좀 둘러보면서 애들이랑 이야기라도 나누고 있어. 금방: Sorry, %s. Have a look around and talk with everyone for now. I'll be right back.
strings.(덩치 큰 남자는 파르밀라를 데리고 가버렸다. 그럼 가볍게 둘러볼까?): (The large man takes Parmila away. Shall I have a quick look around?)
(A young man with an unhealthy pallor. He seems to be saying something, but I can't understand it.)
strings.(그냥 무시하고 지나가기로 했다.): (I decide to ignore him and walk past.)
strings.(뒤에서 부르는 목소리에 돌아보자 밝은 인상의 청년이 서 있다.): (I turn at the voice behind me and see a cheerful-looking young man.)
strings.안녕하세요! 제 이름은 바르문입니다. 단장한테 당신이 올거라는 이야기는: Hello! My name is Barmun. The captain told me you'd be coming.
strings.이 눈 밑 시커먼 녀석의 이름은 그론. 현재 저는 이 녀석의 엄마…아,아: This fellow with the dark circles under his eyes is Gron. Right now, I'm his mother... No, I mean his caregiver.
Gron's health has gotten a little worse since we came here.
strings.어느 정도냐면... 사람 얼굴을 약~간 못 알아보고, 사람 말을 약~간: How much worse? He has a little trouble recognizing faces, has forgotten a little of how to speak, and finds it a little difficult to move around by himself.
Anyway, he wasn't ignoring you deliberately, %s. Please understand.
strings.그론, 햇빛 너무 많이 봤어. 이제 안으로 들어가서 좀 눕자. 다크 서클: Gron, you've had too much sun. Let's go inside and lie down. We don't want those dark circles getting any worse.
strings.(청년은 사람 좋은 미소와 함께 그론을 부축해 안쪽으로 사라졌다.): (With a friendly smile, the young man supports Gron and disappears inside.)
(Parmila has somehow come to stand behind me. Her expression is somber.)
%s... I meant to wait until you'd had more time to settle in here, but...
Gron is the reason I brought you here.
strings.그가 처음부터 저랬던 건 아니야. 그저 말 수가 좀 줄고 멍하니 있는 시: He wasn't like that at first. He just spoke less and spent more time staring into space... I thought he was homesick. He was always quiet.
strings.그러더니 차츰 말을 잊고…어느 순간부터 걷잡을 수 없이 망가지기 시작했어: Then he gradually forgot how to speak... At some point, his condition began deteriorating uncontrollably.
Now he can't do anything on his own.
strings.바르문이 옆에서 열심히 돌보고 있지만… 이젠 육체도 점점 축나기 시작했어: Barmun is doing his best to care for him... but now his body is starting to waste away too.
strings.우리 용병단의 닥터는 뭔가에 중독된 듯한 증세같다고 하는데…: Our company's doctor says the symptoms look like some kind of poisoning...
strings.그론이 특별히 무언가를 하지도 않을 뿐 더러 음식같은 건 모두 함께 만들: But Gron hasn't done anything unusual, and we all prepare and eat the same food.
strings.그론이 탐색을 담당하던 지역도 다른 단원들을 보내서 조사해봤지만 특별할: I sent other members to investigate the area Gron had been scouting, but they found nothing unusual.
That's why I brought you here, %s.
Please find out what made Gron like this.
strings.(퀘스트를 완료할 수 있을 것 같다.): (It looks as though I can complete the quest.)
strings.(인사는 통하지 않은 것 같다!): (The greeting doesn't seem to have worked!)
strings.(한 대 때려볼까 하고 주먹을 그러쥔 순간…): (Just as I clench my fist, wondering whether to hit him...)
strings.(밝은 인상의 청년이 나타나 사이를 가로 막았다.): (A cheerful-looking young man appears and steps between us.)
Oh, you must be %s. The captain told me about you.
strings.그런데 그 꽉 쥔 주먹은 뭘까나~? 설마 %s씨, 환자를 때릴 만큼 나쁜: But what's with that clenched fist? Surely you aren't cruel enough to hit a patient, %s?
Oh, I should introduce myself. My name is Barmun.
strings.(숨겨진 입구로 들어오자 제법 널찍한 공간이 나타났다.): (Beyond the hidden entrance lies a fairly spacious chamber.)
strings.(이곳에 있는 것은 형형한 빛의 마법진과 그 위에 떠 있는 묘한 물체.): (Inside is a brilliantly glowing magic circle, with a strange object floating above it.)
strings.(파르밀라에게 석영 동굴의 숨겨진 지역에 대한 이야기를 했다.): (I tell Parmila about the hidden area in Quartz Cave.)
strings.…석영동굴? 다른 애들이 몇 번이나 살펴봤던 곳인데……. 우린 아무 것도: ...Quartz Cave? The others searched it several times... We couldn't find anything.
Anyway, no time to stand around. Let's go check it at once.
strings.(날카로운 인상의 청년이 앞을 막아선다.): (A sharp-featured young man blocks the way.)
strings.몇 번이나 말씀 드렸지만, 칼로네'씨'라고 부르십시오. 파르밀라. 어딜: I've told you several times to call me 'Mr. Callone,' Parmila. Where are you going?
strings.%s에게 석영 동굴에서 이상한 곳을 발견했다는 말을 들었어요. 확인하러: %s found a strange place in Quartz Cave. We're just going to check it.
strings.이 또한 누누히 말씀 드렸지만, 나에게는 당신들의 모든 행동을 보고해야: As I've also told you repeatedly, I am obliged to report all of your activities.
strings.물론 당신들도 특별한 사안이 발생할 경우 나에게 보고해야 할 의무가 있지: And of course, you're obliged to report anything unusual to me. Please refrain from acting independently without permission.
Quartz Cave, was it? I will accompany you.
...All right. %s can come too, can't they, Mr. Callone?
...I'm not enthusiastic, but since this person must guide us, I suppose there's no choice.
strings.(칼로네의 말에 파르밀라는 인상을 찌푸렸다. 기분이 상한 것 같다.): (Parmila frowns at Callone's words. She seems offended.)
(I return to the strange magic circle deep in the cave with Parmila and Callone.)
strings.그다지 좋지 않은 기운이 느껴지는군요. 파르밀라, 어서 나가도록 합…: I sense an unpleasant energy. Parmila, we should leave...
strings.(파르밀라는 만류하는 칼로네를 지나쳐 무엇에 홀린 것처럼 마법진과 이상한: (Ignoring Callone's warning, Parmila approaches the circle and the strange object as though entranced.)
Callone, look at this. That glow... It's incredible.
strings.이건 뭔가 특별한 힘이 있는 게 분명해! 칼로네, 우리가 엄청난 걸 발견: It must have some special power! Callone, we may have discovered something extraordinary!
strings.(파르밀라는 기쁜 표정으로 조잘조잘 떠들며 마법진 주위를 돌아다니고 있다: (Parmila circles the magic formation, chattering happily.)
strings.(아무 대꾸도 없는 칼로네는 어쩐지 기분이 좋지 않아 보인다.): (Callone says nothing. Somehow, he seems displeased.)
strings.%s! 칼로네! 그렇게 멀찍이 있지 말고 이리 가까이 와서 자세히 좀 봐: %s! Callone! Don't stand so far away. Come closer and look. This craftsmanship is amazing!
strings.(파르밀라의 재촉에 마법진 가까이 다가가 보았다.): (At Parmila's urging, I approach the magic circle.)
strings.(가운데 떠 있는 마법봉은 파르밀라의 말대로 분명 아름답지만…….): (The wand floating in the center is certainly beautiful, as she said, but...)
strings.(잠시 마법봉에 정신이 팔려있는 사이, 계속 재잘대던 파르밀라의 목소리가: (While I'm distracted by the wand, I realize Parmila's constant chatter has stopped.)
strings.(몬스터의 습격인가 했지만 주변엔 아무것도 없다.): (I think it might be a monster attack, but nothing is nearby.)
strings.(마법진 때문일지도 모르겠다. 부숴버릴까 싶어 무기를 꺼내든 순간, 뒤에: (Perhaps the magic circle is responsible. Just as I draw my weapon to destroy it, Callone speaks from behind me, supporting Parmila.)
Stop that pointless behavior. That isn't something you can tamper with lightly.
...What are you? How is something like this possible...?
No, it's nothing. Let's get her out of here.
strings.(몸은 괜찮은 지 물어보았다.): (I ask whether she's feeling all right.)
Yes, I'm fine. I ended up in your debt. Hehe.
strings.사실 나, 기억이 흐릿해. 마법진 앞에서 이것저것 살펴보다가…그러다가……: Actually, my memories are hazy. I was examining things in front of the circle... and then...
strings.(잠시 생각하던 파르밀라는 미간을 찌푸린 채 고개를 저었다.): (Parmila thinks for a moment, then shakes her head with a frown.)
strings.…어쨌든 미안해. 나 때문에 고생이 많았지?: ...Anyway, I'm sorry. I caused you a lot of trouble, didn't I?
I suppose I should thank you too, Callone.
...I told you to call me Mr. Callone.
strings.뭐, 그건 됐고. %s, 칼로네가 그러는데 당신이 마법진을 부쉈다며? 보: Never mind that. %s, Callone says you broke the magic circle. Show me.
strings.(아주 작은 조각이 떨어져나왔을 뿐이라고 대답하고, 파르밀라에게 조각을: (I explain that only a tiny fragment broke off, then hand it to Parmila.)
strings.으음…대체 어떻게 부순거야?: Hmm... How on earth did you break it?
strings.그런데 크기가 작아서 그런가~ 동굴에서 같은 이상한 기분은 안 느껴지는데: Maybe it's because the fragment is small, but I don't feel the strange sensation I felt in the cave.
Anyway, whatever this is, it must have affected Gron...
strings.칼로네. 당신은 제국 출신이잖아요. 이런 거 어디서 본 적 없어요?: Callone, you're from the Empire. Have you ever seen anything like this?
strings.(동굴에서 뭔가 알고 있는 듯이 말했던 칼로네를 바라보았다.): (I look at Callone, who seemed to know something back in the cave.)
strings.(칼로네는 눈이 마주치자 금새 파르밀라에게로 시선을 돌려버렸다.): (As soon as our eyes meet, he turns his gaze back to Parmila.)
No. And please call me Mr. Callone.
strings.아오, 진짜. 좀! 제대로 보기나 하고……. 으으. 됐어요, 됐어. 우리: Oh, honestly! At least look at it properly... Ugh. Fine, fine. I'll ask my people.
strings.그럼 %s. 당신이 이것 좀 애들한테 보여주고 올래?: %s, would you show this to the others?
strings.(이런 이상한 것에 대한 지식이 있을만한 사람은…….): (Who might know about something this strange...?)
strings.이게 뭔가? 뭔 쪼가리야? …구석에 박힌 건 보석인가?: What's this? A fragment of what? ...Is that a gem embedded in the corner?
No, I've never seen it. Jubil's the one who likes gems. I'm not interested.
strings.단장이 나한테 물어보면 알 거라고 했다구?: The captain said I'd know if you asked me?
Hmm... I really don't know. Ask Pikman about something like this.
He's full of all sorts of bizarre knowledge. He might know.
strings.…단장님이 이걸 저한테 보여주라고 했다구요?: ...The captain told you to show this to me?
strings.물론 이 용병단에서 저보다 보석에 대해 잘 아는 사람은 없겠지요. 어디: Of course, nobody in this company knows more about gemstones than I do. Let me see.
...The craftsmanship feels similar to the Empire's.
strings.하지만 이 색상과 반사각…소용돌이 치는 듯한 광채...이런 건…처음 봐요: But this color, the angle of reflection... that swirling glow... I've never seen anything like it.
As I look at it, I feel as though it's calling to me.
strings.…이 조각, 대체 어디서 나신 거지요?: ...Where on earth did you get this fragment?
strings.(동굴에서 있었던 일을 설명했다.): (I explain what happened in the cave.)
strings.우효호호호홋-!!! 수수께끼!! 수수께끼의 향기가 난다!!!!: Woohoohoohoo!! A mystery! I smell a mystery!!!!
strings.그,그거 나줘! 내가 분석해주지!: G-give it to me! I'll analyze it!
strings.히힛, 이히힉. 해부! 해부를 하자!!: Hehe, hehehe! Dissection! Let's dissect it!!
strings.그래서, 피크만. 다들 이렇게 모이라고 한 이유가 뭐야?: So, Pikman. Why did you call everyone together?
Hehe. Captain, my dear comrades... and, as an extra, %s too.
It's time for your hearts to tremble before the genius of the great Pikman! Hahaha!
strings.(피크만이 손에 들고 있던 약병을 높이 들어올려 사람들 눈 앞에 내보인다: (Pikman raises the medicine bottle in his hand for everyone to see.)
strings.이 몸이 드디어 그론의 치료제를 만들어 냈다 이 말씀!!!: I have finally created a cure for Gron!!!
strings.?! 이 짧은 시간 안에 어떻게……?!: ?! How... in such a short time...?!
Don't you make one every day?
The medicine that never makes him any better, you mean.
strings.이이익, 이익. 아냐!! 아니라구!!! 이 천재님을 의심하지 말란 말이다: Grr, no!! No, I tell you!!! Don't doubt this genius! Anyone would struggle if they had to work without a clue!!
strings.하지만 진짜 천재라면…: But if you were a real genius...
Heh... Hahaha... This time is different, I tell you. Hehehe.
strings.단장이 가져온 그 돌조각들은 다들 보셨겠지. 고 녀석을 분석해 봤는데 말: You all saw the stone fragments the captain brought. Well, I analyzed them...
strings.조각에 약간 보이는 이 문자와 여기 사용한 색상으로 추측해보건데 제국의: Judging by the faint lettering on the fragment and the colors used, I thought it might be old imperial magic. So I dug through every ancient book I could find. Hehe.
strings.근데 예상 밖으로 이게 엘프의 마법과 비슷하다 이 말씀! 인간의 손때 냄: But unexpectedly, it's similar to elven magic! Though I can smell human hands on it. Hahaha! ...Anyway, the main purpose of this magic is binding.
strings.여기 봐봐. 이 조각이 뿜어내는 사념이 보여? 안 보인다고? 아주 미미하: Look here. Can you see the psychic force this fragment emits? No? It's faint, but it's there. That force keeps drawing everything around it inward. Forcibly!
strings.예를 들자면 인간의 혼 같은 거? 불러들이고 중심부터 갉아내서 허약해진: Human souls, for example. It pulls them in, eats away at their core, and when they're weak enough... BOOM! It shatters them! BOOM! Hehehe...
strings.피크만~ 사설이 너무 길어. 그래서 본론은?: Pikman, you're rambling. What's the point?
strings.어쨌든 이건 그 사념의 기운을 흩트려버리는 약이란 말이지!!!: Anyway, this medicine disperses that psychic energy!!!
strings.그론이 요놈한테 당한 거라면 분명히 이게 효과 있을 거라 이 말씀~ 캿…: If this thing is what got Gron, it should definitely work! Hahahaha! Now, young Barmun, give it to him!
strings.(바르문은 미심쩍은 표정으로 그론에게 약병 안에 든 것을 먹이기 시작했다: (Looking doubtful, Barmun begins giving Gron the contents of the bottle.)
It's a creation of the genius Pikman! It'll work in no time. Hahaha.
strings.(괴로운 표정과 함께 한참동안 몸을 뒤척이던 그론이 고개를 들었다.): (After twisting in discomfort for some time, Gron raises his head.)
strings.바르문…왜…? 어라아… 다들 여기서 뭐…하는 거에요?: Barmun... Why...? Huh... What are you all... doing here?
strings.!!! 그론!!! 나 알아보겠어? 그론!!!: !!! Gron!!! Do you recognize me? Gron!!!
Y-yes, Barmun. I can hear you without the shouting.
strings.(바르문은 감격스러운 표정으로 그론을 끌어 안았다. 눈가가 촉촉해진 것: (Overcome with emotion, Barmun embraces Gron. His eyes seem moist, but perhaps I should pretend not to notice.)
strings.으응? 갑자기 왜 이래~?: Huh? What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
strings.너…너 하나도 기억 안나는 거야?: You... don't remember any of it?
strings.그론? 그론?! 야!!! 야, 너 왜 이래!!! 눈 떠봐!!!! 그론!!: Gron? Gron?! Hey!!! What's wrong with you?! Open your eyes!!!! Gron!!!
strings.(작은 비명과 함께 그론은 정신을 잃었다. 바르문이 늘어진 그론의 몸을: (With a small cry, Gron loses consciousness. Barmun shakes his limp body frantically.)
Oh no... Gron has gone back to the way he was... And he's drooling... He seems even worse.
He seemed lucid for a moment. Was it a failure?
strings.크으… 배합은 정확했는데 말이지. 피유…생각보다 사념에 강하게 붙들려 있: Urgh... The mixture was correct. Phew... It seems the psychic force has a stronger hold on him than I thought...
strings.그럼 그론이 돌아올 방법은 없는 거야…?: Then there's no way to bring Gron back...?
strings.%s. 계속 부탁만 하게 되어 미안하지만 조금만 더 우리를 도와줄 수 있: %s. I'm sorry to keep asking, but could you help us a little longer?
strings.(마법진이 남아있는 한 그론에게 약은 소용이 없는가보다. 다른 대책을 강: (As long as the magic circle remains, medicine may be useless for Gron. We'll need another solution.)
strings.(혹시 다른 단서를 찾을 수 있지 않을까하는 생각에 다시 찾아온 석영 동: (I return to the depths of Quartz Cave, hoping to find another clue...)
You really do get on my nerves at every turn.
strings.(마법진 구석구석을 살피고 만져보며 무엇을 하고 있던 중인 지 물어보았다: (I ask why he was inspecting and touching every part of the magic circle.)
strings.별 거 안 했습니다. 혹여 그론씨를 원래대로 돌려놓을 방법을 찾을 수 있: I wasn't doing anything much. I came to see whether I could find a way to restore Gron.
strings.당신은 여기 무슨 일 입니까. 파르밀라가 시켜서 왔나요?: What are you doing here? Did Parmila send you?
strings.어찌됐건 저것… 저 마법진에는 가까이 가지 마십시오. 아무리 저 기운에: Whatever the case, don't approach that... that magic circle. Even if its energy doesn't affect you, staying here too long isn't good.
strings.(칼로네는 마법진의 힘에 영향을 받지 않는 걸까?): (Is Callone unaffected by the magic circle's power?)
strings.그야 저는 저것에 익숙하니까, 몇 가지 노하우만 있으면 저 아티팩트는 그: Well, I'm familiar with it. With a little know-how, that artifact isn't particularly...
strings.실언했습니다. 네? 무슨 말씀이신지?: That was a slip of the tongue. Pardon? What do you mean?
strings.아뇨? 전 저게 뭔지 잘…전혀 모르겠는데요?: No? I don't really... I don't know what that is at all.
...I'm starting to resent Parmila for bringing you here.
strings.조심성 없는 제 입도 원망스럽고……: And I resent my own careless mouth...
Very well. I'll tell you what you want to know.
strings.(칼로네에게 퀘스트를 완료할 수 있을 것 같다.): (It looks as though I can complete the quest with Callone.)
strings.…전 처음 만났을 때부터 당신이 마음에 들지 않았습니다. 뭔가 남다른 구: ...I disliked you from the moment we met. I thought it was because something about you was different.
Perhaps that feeling was a premonition of this moment.
strings.당신도 무언가 추측하는 바가 있을 터. 억측으로 오해받고 싶지 않으니 제: You must already have your suspicions. I don't want you misunderstanding through speculation, so I'll explain myself.
strings.저는 본디 제국 내 사설 마법 연구원 제 2연구소 소속입니다. 그곳에서: I originally belonged to Laboratory No. 2 of a private magical research institute within the Empire. I served as its director, leading and supervising the researchers.
We sought to study the domination and control of human emotions through fear.
strings.극한의 공포에 노출될 때 발휘되는 인간의 초인적인 힘. 그 상태에서 공포: Humans display superhuman strength when exposed to extreme terror. If we could remove only the emotion of fear from that state, perhaps they could control that strength rationally...
...That was the subject of our research.
But our research reached a limit.
strings.인간의 감정이란 역치를 가지는 법. 사람들은 어느 순간 공포를 극복해버리: Human emotions have thresholds. At some point, people overcame their fear, which took us in a direction different from the result we wanted.
strings.그 때 손에 들어온 것이 바로 눈 앞에 보이는 저것, 데고스의 아티팩트였: That was when we obtained what you see before you: Degos's artifact.
strings.입수 경로까지 당신에게 설명할 필요는 없겠지요. 데고스라는 존재에 대해: I needn't explain how we acquired it. Do you know the being called Degos?
That is something like a magical circuit containing a concentration of Degos's demonic power.
strings.우리는 저것을 분석하여 인간을 초월한 존재가 줄 수 있는 공포, 그것을: We intended to analyze it and create an object that could continuously inflict upon humans the terror produced by a being beyond humanity.
strings.대상은 지독한 공포에 정신을 놔버릴 뿐, 우리가 원하는 매커니즘으로 움직: The subjects merely lost their minds to overwhelming fear. They did not function through the mechanism we intended.
strings.…당신은 이미 예상하고 있을 지도 모르겠군요. 그론의 상태는 바로 저것: ...You may already have guessed. That must be what caused Gron's condition.
strings.동굴을 탐색하는 동안 그 입구를 찾아냈고, 조사를 하는 동안 아티팩트의: He must have found the entrance while exploring the cave, then been exposed to the artifact's power while investigating.
strings.아티팩트의 영향이 지속될 수록 그런 상태가 돼버린 다는 건 이번에 처음: This is the first time I've learned that prolonged exposure can cause such a condition, but...
I don't know why he didn't tell anyone before it became so severe.
strings.…그 표정은 뭔가요. 내가 잔인하게 느껴집니까?: ...What is that expression? Do I seem cruel to you?
strings.연구는 실패했고, 프로젝트는 종료되었습니다. 저는 좌천 되다시피 이곳으로: The research failed, and the project ended. I was sent here in what was effectively a demotion.
strings.하지만 어떻게 저 아티팩트가 이곳에 있는 건지…저도 도대체 이해가 되지: But how that artifact came to be here... I don't understand it either.
strings.데고스. 타락한 군주. 마계의 로드 중 하나이며 일명 격노의 화신이라 불: Degos. The fallen ruler. One of the lords of the demon realm, also called the Incarnation of Rage. Rumor says he was originally human, but there's no way to verify it.
strings.강대한 마의 힘을 가진 존재로 이 땅 어딘가에 봉인되어 있으며, 봉인이: A being of tremendous demonic power, sealed somewhere in this land. They say that when his seal breaks, he will bring the end of this world.
strings.물론 저도 제 눈으로 확인한 적은 없습니다만…: Of course, I've never seen him with my own eyes...
In any case, if my deductions are correct, that is an artifact containing Degos's power.
strings.(이야기를 다 들은 파르밀라는 의외로 담담해보였다.): (After hearing the whole story, Parmila seems unexpectedly calm.)
strings.말하자면 당신들은 결국 감정이 없는 인간 병기를 만드려고 했던 거군요?: So, in other words, you were trying to create emotionless human weapons?
strings.아뇨! 오해입니다. 우리는 순수히 인간에게 숨겨진 초월적인 힘을 연구하려: No! You've misunderstood. We only sought to study the hidden, transcendent power within humans. We never intended to misuse it!
strings.그건 당신 혼자만의 생각 아닌가요? 모두가 그 생각에 동의했었나요?: Isn't that just your own opinion? Did everyone agree with you?
strings.…물론…모든 연구는 실용성을 띄어야 한다는 주장을 하는 무리도 있긴 했었: ...Of course... there were some who argued that all research must have practical applications...
Your master probably thought the same way.
Anyway, your research succeeded in the end. Without you, Callone...
strings.아마 그런 것 같습니다. 저는 실패를 보고하고 얼마 지나지 않아 급히 이: It seems so. Shortly after reporting our failure, I was hurriedly sent here. But seeing that, I can only conclude that they succeeded afterward.
strings.우리의 연구가 성공하였을 시 예상되었던 형태입니다. 대체 어떻게… 그보다: It's the form we predicted our successful research would take. How on earth... And why did I have to be excluded...? I truly don't understand. I'm confused.
strings.…난 당신들의 이기적인 실험에 우리 그론이 피해를 입어야한다는 사실이 더: ...What I don't understand is why our Gron had to suffer because of your selfish experiments.
Forget it. Blaming you won't restore Gron.
It's because you seem to be a victim too, and I feel sorry for you.
Callone, you looked intelligent, but perhaps you aren't.
Do you still not understand? You were used and discarded.
strings.자신의 계략을 모두 알고 있으면서 그것에 반대하는 능력있는 부하. 눈엣가: A capable subordinate who knows all of his master's plans and opposes them. You must have been a thorn in his side.
strings.막강한 힘을 가진 병기를 처음 시험해 볼 대상으로 딱 좋지 않아요?: Wouldn't you be the perfect first target for testing an immensely powerful weapon?
strings.내,내가…이용 당한 거라니…그럴리가… 읏…: I... was used...? That can't be... Ugh...
Of course, it looks as though we were prepared as guinea pigs for that weapon too...
strings.…어쩐지 쓸데없이 보수가 좋다고 생각했어. 쯧…: ...I thought the pay was suspiciously good. Tsk...
strings.(앞으로 어떻게 할 지 파르밀라에게 물어보았다.): (I ask Parmila what she plans to do next.)
I wonder. My head is spinning too.
strings.일단 다른 단원들한텐 비밀로 해줘. 억지로 일을 복잡하게 만들고 싶지도: Keep this secret from the other members for now. I don't want to make things more complicated. And...
I especially don't want to see Barmun charging in and demanding that we kill Callone.
strings.(칼로네를 흘긋 바라보는 파르밀라의 말투는 가히 냉소적이다.): (Parmila glances at Callone, her tone unmistakably cynical.)
strings.!!! 읏… 죄,죄송합니다. 제가 한 일은 아니라고 하지만…용병단 여러분: !!! Ugh... I-I'm sorry. Even if I didn't do it myself... I deeply apologize for the harm caused to your company...
strings.보, 본국에 연락을 해서 보수도 더 올려드리겠습니다!: I-I'll contact my homeland and have your payment increased!
strings.그러니까~ 애초에 버리는 패인데 그게 가능하겠냐구요. (한숨): That's what I'm saying. You were a disposable pawn from the start. How would that be possible? Sigh...
Callone, you're much more foolish than you look.
strings.내가 당신에게 바라는 일은 그런 게 아니에요. 당신네들의 더러운 뒷공작에: That isn't what I want from you. I don't want to get tangled in your people's filthy schemes either...
What I want is that artifact destroyed.
strings.그론을 변하게 만든 저 근원을 척살해버리면, 피크만의 약으로 그론은 나을: If we destroy the source of what changed Gron, Pikman's medicine should cure him and bring him back to us. Am I wrong?
strings.칼로네, 저 아티팩트를 부수는 방법, 알고 있죠? 저걸 연구하던 당신이라: Callone, you know how to destroy it, don't you? You studied it. You must know.
strings.저,저는 실패해서 연구소에서 내쫓긴 거나 마찬가지고… 저 완성된 아티팩트: I-I failed and was practically thrown out of the institute... And I didn't create that completed artifact...
strings.아뇨. 해야만 할 거에요. 못한다고 하면 내가 당신을 죽여버릴 지도 모르: No. You'll have to. If you tell me you can't, I might kill you.
strings.%s. 내키지 않지만 당신의 도움이 필요할 것 같습니다. 저를 좀 도와주: %s. Reluctant as I am, I think I'll need your help. Would you assist me?
strings.이제부터 %s에게 받은 재료들로 아티팩트에 봉인된 데고스의 힘을 끌어내도: I will now use the materials %s brought to draw out Degos's power sealed within the artifact.
strings.파르밀라, 당신은 다른 곳으로 피해 있는 게 좋지 않겠습니까?: Parmila, wouldn't it be better for you to take shelter elsewhere?
I can look after myself. Don't worry about me.
strings.(파르밀라의 눈동자는 결의에 차 있다. 칼로네는 작게 한숨을 내쉰 뒤 말: (Parmila's eyes are filled with resolve. Callone sighs quietly, then continues.)
strings.계획은 이렇습니다. 미르간디아의 힘이 담긴 이 보석들을 이용해서 아티팩트: Here's the plan. I'll use these gems, which hold Mirgandia's power, to alter the artifact's magical circuits. Their structure will invert, the power will flow in reverse, and Degos's sealed power will be drawn out.
strings.그렇게 되면 제가 새로 새겨넣은 이 마력 회로들이 그 힘을 실체화 할 겁: Then the new magical circuits I've engraved will give that power physical form. After that, %s, you must destroy the manifestation of Degos's power.
strings.아니오. 파르밀라. 실체화 된 마의 힘은 훨씬 위력이 강할 겁니다. 지난: No, Parmila. Once manifested, the demonic power will be far stronger. It may not end with you merely losing consciousness this time.
strings.왜인지 모르지만 저 힘에 전혀 영향을 받지 않는 %s에게 맡겨두는 편이: For reasons I don't understand, %s is completely unaffected by it. Leaving this to the adventurer is safer.
If something happened to you too... I couldn't face the mercenaries.
strings.(칼로네의 말에 파르밀라는 납득했는 지 마지못해 고개를 끄덕이며 뒤로 물: (Seemingly convinced by Callone's words, Parmila reluctantly nods and steps back.)
strings.당신의 역할이 가장 중요합니다. 당신이 실수하면...잘못하면 우리 모두가: Your role is the most important. If you make a mistake... all of us could be in danger.
strings.(칼로네는 아티팩트의 이 곳 저 곳을 건드리고 다니기 시작했다.): (Callone begins working on various parts of the artifact.)
strings.(무슨 일을 하는 지 이해할 수 없으므로 파르밀라와 얌전히 기다리기로 했: (Since I can't understand what he's doing, I decide to wait quietly with Parmila.)
strings.(얼마만큼의 시간이 흘렀을까… 칼로네가 이쪽을 돌아보았다.): (How much time has passed...? Callone turns toward us.)
strings.자, 다 됐습니다. 이제 이것을 작동 시키면…: It's ready. Now, if I activate this...
strings.(칼로네는 손에 들고 있던 마지막 보석 조각을 아티팩트의 홈에 밀어넣었다: (Callone presses the last gem fragment in his hand into a groove in the artifact.)
strings.(칼로네는 다시 아티팩트를 여기저기 손보기 시작했지만, 곧 체념한 표정이: (Callone starts adjusting the artifact again, but soon his expression becomes resigned.)
strings.이것은 이미 제가 감당할 수 있는 수준이 아닌 것 같습니다. …정말 죄송: This appears to be beyond what I can handle now. ...I'm truly sorry.
strings.그런 무책임한 소린 듣고 싶지 않다구요!!!: I don't want to hear such irresponsible words!!!
strings.(일단 칼로네에게 퀘스트를 완료하자.): (For now, let's complete the quest with Callone.)
Have you forgotten already...? Are you really an idiot?
strings.그냥 실체화 된 데고스가 튀어나오면 잡으면 됩니다! 멍청이라도 이정도는: When the manifested Degos appears, just defeat it! Even an idiot should understand that much.
strings.(파르밀라와 칼로네가 놀란 토끼눈을 하고 바라보고 있다.): (Parmila and Callone stare at me with wide, startled eyes.)
strings.괜찮은 거야?? 갑자기 사라져버려서 깜짝 놀랐잖아!! 걱정했다구!: Are you all right? You suddenly disappeared! You scared us!! I was worried!
strings.(두 사람에게 아티팩트 근처에서 쁘띠 데고스가 나타난 것과 그것을 물리쳤: (I explain that Petit Degos appeared near the artifact and that I defeated it.)
strings.(아마 두 사람에게는 쁘띠 데고스의 모습이 보이지 않았던 것 같다.): (Apparently, neither of them could see Petit Degos.)
strings.%s의 설명이 사실이라면, 아티팩트에 봉인된 데고스의 힘을 실체화 시키는: If %s's explanation is true, then we succeeded in manifesting Degos's power sealed within the artifact.
strings.왜 당신에게만 그것이 보였는 지는…저도 설명하기 어렵군요. 마의 힘이 공: Why only you could see it... I can't explain. Did the demonic power distort space?
strings.어쨌든 그리 불완전한 외형으로 실체화 되었다면, 이 아티팩트도 완전한 완: In any case, if it manifested in such an incomplete form, I suspect the artifact itself was not fully perfected.
And you defeated Degos too... That is excellent news.
strings.그럼 이제 그론은 원래대로 돌아오는 건가?: Then will Gron return to normal now?
strings.잔존하는 사념과 아티팩트의 링크는 끊겼을테니, 이제 피크만의 약으로도 호: The link between the lingering psychic force and the artifact should be severed. I believe Pikman's medicine will help now, though I don't know how long it will take...
strings.확실히 원래대로 돌아올 수 있기만 하다면 시간은 얼마가 걸리더라도 상관없: As long as he can definitely return to normal, I don't care how long it takes.
strings.자, 두 사람. 이제 주둔지로 돌아갑시다. 여기 입구는 이제 폐쇄해버리기: All right, both of you. Let's return to camp. We'll seal this entrance now.
One job wrapped up, then! It was hectic, but somehow we managed to settle it.
strings.%s, 도와줘서 정말 고마워. 나 때문에 이 먼 곳까지 와서 엄청 고생: %s, thank you so much for helping. You came all this way because of me and went through so much. I'll never forget this favor. And...
You don't need to be so wary. I really... simply want to thank you.
For giving Gron back to us.
strings.흠…흠흠. 별 말씀을요. 도리어 저는 오스큐라스 여러분께 사과를 드려야하: Ahem... Ahem. Not at all. Rather, I'm the one who owes everyone in the Oscuras company an apology.
strings.비록 제가 직접 저지른 일이 아닐지라도 자초한 일이니만큼 끝까지 책임을: Even if I didn't do it directly, I helped bring it about. Of course I should take responsibility to the end.
I intend to return to my homeland and confront them in person.
strings.아, 걱정 마십시오. 보수 지급에 대한 부분은 말끔하게 처리해두도록 하겠: Oh, don't worry. I'll make sure your payment is settled properly.
strings.당신 거기 돌아가면 죽을 지도 모른다구요!!: If you go back there, you might be killed!!
strings.…예, 그럴지도 모르지요. 하지만 제가 추구한 연구의 결과가 그런 것이라: ...Yes, perhaps. But if that is the result of the research I pursued, I believe it cannot be helped.
strings.내 주위엔 왜 이렇게 요령없는 멍청이가 많은 거야!: Why am I surrounded by so many clueless idiots?
strings.네, 제가 죽음으로 책임지겠습니다하고 죽어버리면, 그게 끝이에요? 그건: If you say, 'I'll take responsibility with my life,' and die, is that the end of it? That's only running away to ease your own conscience!
strings.정말 잘못했다고 생각하고, 책임을 지고 싶다고 생각하면, 현실을 똑바로: If you truly think you've done wrong and want to take responsibility, you have to face reality and choose the most useful course!
strings.…지금으로선 이게 가장 합리적인 방법이라고 생각했습니다만…: ...I thought this was the most reasonable approach available...
May I make a proposal, Callone?
Don't report anything to the Empire. Join us instead.
strings.그리고 탐사는 무사히 진행되고 있다는 거짓 보고를 하는 거죠. 이를테면: And send false reports saying the exploration is proceeding smoothly. A spy, you might say?
strings.그러면 당신도 죽지 않아도 되고, 우리도 일자리를 잃지 않아도 되고, 계: Then you don't have to die, we don't lose our jobs, and we keep earning money! ...And we won't let them push us around as they please.
strings.난 이게 매우 합리적인 방법이라고 생각하는데, 당신은 어떤가요?: I think it's an extremely reasonable approach. What do you think?
strings.(잠시 고민하던 표정의 칼로네는 파르밀라가 웃으며 내민 손을 맞잡았다.): (After considering for a moment, Callone takes the hand Parmila offers with a smile.)
...Then perhaps I'll join on a provisional basis.
strings.어라? 신입 주제에 이런 고자세~? 이런, 벌써부터 입단 권유가 후회가: Oh? Such an attitude from a new recruit! I'm already starting to regret inviting you!
Heh... Then I look forward to working with you, Captain.
Ugh... Y-you hold grudges more than one would expect. Captain... ma'am.
strings.아하하하하. 그럼 애들한테 인사하러 갈까요~?: Ahahahaha! Shall we go say hello to everyone?
strings.드디어 칼로네와 친해질 수 있다고, 바르문이 기뻐하겠는 걸?: Barmun will be delighted that he can finally get to know you, Callone.
strings.(칼로네는 진심으로 괴로운 표정을 지으며 비척비척 앞서 걷기 시작했다.): (Looking genuinely distressed, Callone begins trudging ahead.)
strings.(축 늘어진 두 어깨를 안타까워하고 있을 때, 파르밀라가 속삭이듯 말을: (As I look sympathetically at his slumped shoulders, Parmila speaks in a whisper.)
Let me thank you properly once more.
As leader of the Oscuras Mercenaries, I sincerely thank you.
strings.저기, 괜찮다면 당신도 우리 용병단에 들어오지 않을래?: Um, if you'd like, would you join our company too?
strings.(마음은 고맙지만, 거절하기로 했다.): (I'm grateful for the offer, but decide to decline.)
All right. Somehow, I thought you'd refuse... Still, it's a shame.
strings.그럼 명예 단원 시켜줄테니까, 언제든지 놀러와야 해?: Then I'll make you an honorary member. Come visit anytime, all right?
